subtle.description: Tinted surface for selected / highlighted rows.

base.description: Light neutral used for header, footer and comparison bar in dark mode.

border.description: Hairline on the spine; also the spine's edge against the navy/950 page ground.

background.description: Score chip fill stays ink navy in dark mode (same value as light by design).

contrast.description: Dark text on the amber control background.

base.description: Brightened sky so info-base text on info-subtle keeps WCAG AA in dark mode (Phase 4).
App canvas behind all content in dark mode. Deepest Midnight Ledger navy (navy.950).

secondary.description: Supporting copy, captions, meta in dark mode.

tertiary.description: Placeholders, disabled labels in dark mode.

link.description: Brightened navy so link text keeps WCAG AA on dark surfaces (9.63:1 on surface).

strong.description: Emphasised borders and dividers in dark mode.

focus.description: Focus ring color in dark mode. Brand gold: 8.72:1 on the dark ground.

hoverSurface.description: Row / list-item hover background in dark mode.

brand.description: Midnight Ledger brand gradient for dark mode: navy tonal steps (replaces the legacy indigo/violet literals).

header.description: Animated site header background for dark mode.

background.description: Page background gradient for dark mode (navy.950 to navy.800).

white.description: Pure white. Use for surfaces and text on dark backgrounds.

black.description: Pure black. Rarely used directly; prefer slate-900 for dark surfaces.

100.description: Midnight Ledger warm paper page ground.

200.description: Recessed step below the paper ground.

900.description: Midnight Ledger ink for body text.

gradientFrom.description: Midnight Ledger brand gradient start: ink navy. (Replaces the legacy indigo #4f46b8.)

subtle.description: Tinted surface for selected / highlighted rows.

contrast.description: Text/icon color placed on top of primary.

base.description: Brand accent (logo dot, premium/active highlights). Decorative on light grounds — see gold.500 contrast note.

text.description: Deep gold for gold-coloured TEXT on light grounds (plan V2 §2.3 goldDeep role; Community reviewed chip, P3): 4.71:1 on accent.subtle, 5.18:1 on white. Brand gold (accent.base) is never text on light.

contrast.description: Ink text on gold (6.43:1 on gold.500); white on gold is only 2.3:1 and must not be used.

base.description: Dark neutral used for header, footer and comparison bar.

background.description: Midnight Ledger spine: the app rail, top bar, bottom bar, command palette and footer sit on ink navy in BOTH themes (redesign plan V2, P1). Paper text on it is 15.34:1.

surfaceHover.description: Hover well on the spine. Secondary text (navy/300) on it is 5.99:1.

surfaceSelected.description: Selected/active well on the spine. Paper text on it is 12.28:1, secondary text 5.28:1.

text.description: Primary text on the spine (15.34:1 on shell/background).

textSecondary.description: Secondary text on the spine (6.60:1 on shell/background).

background.description: CreditMate Score chip fill, ink navy in BOTH themes (redesign plan V2, P2). Gold numeral on it is 7.09:1 (light) / ~8.0:1 (dark); paper band word is ~15.3:1.

numeral.description: Score numeral in Fraunces on the navy chip. Gold is text-grade on navy only — never on paper.

text.description: Score band word on the navy chip.

background.description: Advisor citation chip fill, ink navy in BOTH themes (redesign plan V2, P5). Gold's second structural job: the numeral signals 'sourced'. Paper label on it is 15.34:1.

numeral.description: Citation index numeral on the navy chip (7.09:1). Gold is text-grade on navy only — never on paper.

text.description: Citation label on the navy chip.

base.description: Darkened amber so warning-base text on warning-subtle keeps WCAG AA (Phase 4).

contrast.description: White text on the darkened amber base for AA contrast (Phase 4).

base.description: App canvas behind all content. Warm paper (Midnight Ledger), replacing the cool lavender-grey #ECEEF3.

muted.description: Striped rows, code blocks, disabled areas. Recessed step below the paper ground.

inverse.description: Dark strips such as the comparison bar.

overlay.description: Scrim behind modals and popups (ink navy at 60%).

link.description: Link text. Primary navy (11.2:1 on the paper ground). Brand gold is never used for links — #C9A227 on paper is only 2.17:1.

subtle.description: Warm hairline dividers and card edges on the paper ground.

focus.description: Focus ring color, pairs with shadow.focus.

hoverSurface.description: Row / list-item hover background. Warm step between paper ground and muted.

brand.description: Midnight Ledger brand gradient: ink navy to primary navy (tonal).

header.description: Animated site header background (see GradientHeader). Midnight Ledger navy tonal steps.

cardAccent.description: Card accent stripe: primary navy to brand gold.

press.description: Press feedback. Redesign plan range: 80-160ms (motion ceiling 500ms).

standard.description: Standard transitions. Redesign plan range: 180-250ms (motion ceiling 500ms).

large.description: Large surface transitions. Redesign plan range: 240-360ms (motion ceiling 500ms).

easeOut.description: Ease-out for entrances and press feedback.

none.description: Square corners. Use for full-bleed strips and tables.

md.description: Matches the legacy --radius-md (0.375rem) already used by buttons, rows and cards.

lg.description: Matches the legacy --radius-lg (0.5rem) already used by panels and modals.

none.description: Flat surfaces. Prefer over removing the property entirely.

xs.description: Resting state for dense lists and inline controls. Navy-tinted stop (plan V2 §2.6: all shadow stops are navy rgba(15, 27, 51, …), never slate).

sm.description: Matches the legacy --shadow-sm already used by inputs, cards and popovers.

card.description: Resting elevation for cards and panels that sit directly on the tinted page ground. Ledger rule (plan V2 §2.6): hairline border + whisper shadow, navy-tinted stops (was slate-tinted).

md.description: Default card shadow. Identical to the current AnimatedCard shadow.

lg.description: Hover and raised state. Identical to the current card hover shadow.

inner.description: Inset wells such as disabled or read-only inputs. Navy-tinted stop (plan V2 §2.6).

focus.description: Keyboard focus ring. Pair with color.border.focus. Midnight Ledger (plan V2 §2.6): primary navy rgba(29, 50, 96, .35) — replaces the legacy blue rgba(37, 99, 235, .35) that survived P0. One shared value serves both themes (shadow.json is theme-agnostic); in dark the ring's visibility is carried by the gold border/focus colour it pairs with.

12.description: The 12px step the plan adds to the 4px scale.

none.description: Explicit zero. Use instead of omitting padding/margin when documented.

md.description: 4px base unit x4. Default padding for cards and sections.

lg.description: 4px base unit x6. Default card padding in the current UI.

3xl.description: 4px base unit x16. Hero / large page blocks.

4xl.description: 4px base unit x24. Full-bleed section rhythm.

instant.description: State changes that must feel immediate.

fast.description: Hover, focus, and small colour changes.

easeInOut.description: Default easing for moves and fades.

colors.description: Properties for hover/focus colour feedback. Expanded into a valid CSS shorthand by transition.preset.colors.

singleColor.description: Safe to combine with duration and easing in a single shorthand.

colors.value: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), fill 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), stroke 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)
colors.description: Each property carries its own duration/easing: CSS only honours timing functions on the trailing shorthand entry.

singleColor.description: Ready-to-use shorthand for a single property.

shadow.description: Ready-to-use shorthand: elevation changes on cards.

sans.value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Hind Siliguri', 'Noto Sans Bengali', sans-serif
sans.description: System UI stack with Bengali fallbacks ('Hind Siliguri', 'Noto Sans Bengali') so Bengali glyphs fall through to Hind Siliguri. Matches the existing body font in src/styles/index.css.

display.description: Midnight Ledger display face (self-hosted, see src/styles/fonts.css). Wordmark, hero and display headings only — UI text stays on the sans stack. Hind Siliguri follows so Bengali display text keeps its face.

mono.value: source-code-pro, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

3xl.description: Hero headings on tablet and up.
